listings.description: This two bedroom, two bathroom townhome at Tributary 50 blends spacious design with upgraded features. The unit includes an extra lofted den, offering a versatile space for a study or relaxation area. The private garage and entry offers the ultimate convenience. The covered balcony adds an outdoor element, perfect for quiet mornings or evening gatherings. An oversized primary bedroom suite provides a comfortable escape, complemented by the living room’s two-story window wall and double height ceilings that invite an abundance of natural light. Elevated finishes like quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, wine refrigerator, and tile showers will make you feel at home.
amenities: Glass-Top Electric Range Oven and Stove
